description: Monthly first releases of the county LAUS vintages (fred_county_laus_monthly_vintages): for each county, family and reference month, the value from the earliest vintage that released it, dated by that vintage, so the panel is never revised and an as-of view of it carries no revision leakage. The archive's opening snapshot of already-revised history is excluded, values carry the units the source harmonised each vintage to, and coverage before reference month 2007-05 is the Federal Reserve Eighth District rather than the nation. Written by the embedding layer's realtime_panel builder, not by a stage pipeline.
